title: SmartSens bets US$225M on China's 40nm CIS foundry capacity despite mounting losses
html:
Chinese fabless chip designer SmartSens plans to invest CNY1.5 billion (≈ US$225 million) in Wuhan Chuxing Technology, acquiring a 5.588% stake in one of China's few 40nm CMOS image sensor (CIS) foundries...

summary: Chinese fabless chip designer SmartSens plans to invest CNY1.5 billion (≈ US$225 million) in Wuhan Chuxing Technology, acquiring a 5.588% stake in one of China's few 40nm CMOS image sensor (CIS) foundries.
